data.short_description: Sun House Cafe moved to a larger space at 1805 Capitol Ave., next to Zócalo and Fieldwork Brewing Co. The new space is about 1,400 square feet.

data.location: Pavilion at Goldring Woldenberg Riverfront Park, 1 Canal St, New Orleans, LA 70130
data.short_description: Crew Hospitality was selected to develop and operate a new restaurant and bar inside the riverfront park pavilion. The venue appears to draw inspiration from the group's Manhattan concept Drift-In.

data.location: French Quarter, New Orleans
data.short_description: Crew Hospitality's cocktail bar concept Holywater is now open in the French Quarter.

data.location: 475 Central Ave, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
data.short_description: Acropolis Greek Taverna is returning to St. Pete near its former location, which closed about three years ago. Owner Sam Waez confirmed that the restaurant is aiming for an opening in early December.

data.location: 4670 International Parkway, Sanford, FL 32771
data.short_description: The quick-service Indian restaurant will use self-service kiosks and offer a menu drawn from several regions of India. Plans were filed on October 29, 2026, and an exact opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 5114 Veterans Parkway, Murfreesboro, TN 37128
data.short_description: Franchisee Who Brew LLC is developing a new 7 Brew drive-thru stand in west Murfreesboro. A new-construction permit was issued on September 10, 2026, and no opening date has been announced.

data.location: Address not specified (neighboring 5114 Veterans Parkway, Murfreesboro)
data.short_description: An Instagram post identified a Chipotle project next to the upcoming 7 Brew site.

data.location: 190 Marietta Street NW, Suite 200, Atlanta, GA 30313
data.short_description: Mastro's Ocean Club opened its first Georgia restaurant at The CTR in Downtown Atlanta. It occupies the former McCormick & Schmick's space on the ground floor of the former CNN Center.

data.location: The CTR, Downtown Atlanta
data.short_description: Live-K Karaoke is a planned addition at The CTR. It is expected to open in 2027.

data.location: The CTR, Downtown Atlanta
data.short_description: The Looking Glass is a planned addition at The CTR. It is expected to open in 2027.

data.location: 139 N Ridgewood Dr., Suite 103, Sebring, FL 33870
data.short_description: The new restaurant will combine a steakhouse experience and Mexican cuisine with a Japanese omakase sushi counter. A representative confirmed the opening, and the menu is still under development.

data.location: 4006 Martin Luther King Jr. Way, Oakland, CA 94609
data.short_description: The original Oakland location of the bar and pizza spot will permanently close on December 20, and the location is up for sale. The Emeryville location will remain open.

data.location: Downtown Hayward
data.short_description: The owners announced plans to open a new location in downtown Hayward. More announcements are expected over the next couple of months.

data.location: 232 N. Larchmont Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90004
data.short_description: The Larchmont Village restaurant, the last remaining location of a chain that once had 19 locations, will close. Its final day of service is November 25.

data.location: 912 St. Johns Avenue, Palatka, FL 32177
data.short_description: Caruzinn Café is opening its second location in downtown Palatka. A permit application filed in November is in process, and no opening date has been shared.

data.location: 2895 State Road 16, Suite 110, St. Augustine, FL 32092
data.short_description: A permit application filed in October lists Hanami Sushi and Grill, Inc. for a planned restaurant. The application is in plan review, and no construction timeline or opening date has been announced.

data.location: Northwest corner of Beach Boulevard and St. Johns Bluff Road South, Jacksonville (11355 Beach Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32246)
data.short_description: Parker's Kitchen is planning a gas station and convenience store on about 1.59 acres. An October permit covers site work only, and no opening date has been announced.

data.location: 1762 U.S. Highway 90 East, Suite 105, Castroville, TX 78009
data.short_description: TDLR records show a $415,000 tenant fit-out at Town East Crossing. Construction is scheduled from November 18, 2026 to January 15, 2027, and those dates do not confirm an opening date.

data.location: 5024 Hunter Road, Ooltewah, TN 37363
data.short_description: MEP drawings are being finalized before the plans are submitted to the City of Chattanooga for approval. Construction is expected to take about two and a half months after approval, and no opening date has been confirmed.

data.location: 121 Frazier Avenue, Chattanooga, TN 37405
data.short_description: The North Shore doughnut shop is being renovated and rebranded under new owner Cassie Burke. The existing recipes will be kept, and no reopening date was given.

data.location: 712 N. Glendale Avenue, Glendale, CA 91206
data.short_description: [solidcore] is preparing to open a new strength-training studio in Glendale. The company has not announced an opening date.

data.location: Westfield Topanga, 6600 Topanga Canyon Blvd, Canoga Park, CA 91303
data.short_description: The modular furniture brand will open a showroom at Westfield Topanga by the end of January 2027. VP of Real Estate Clary Groen confirmed the timeline.

data.location: Westfield UTC, 4545 La Jolla Village Drive, San Diego, CA 92122
data.short_description: 7th Avenue plans a new showroom at Westfield UTC in La Jolla, expected to open in spring 2027. Groen said it is the company's only other planned Southern California opening over roughly the next year.

data.location: 1275 Foothill Blvd, La Verne, CA 91750, United States (Gateway Pointe)
data.status: preparing to open; listed as a coming-soon location
data.short_description: Crunch Fitness is preparing to open a new gym at Gateway Pointe in La Verne this December, operated by franchisee Fitness Ventures. The club will offer strength and cardio equipment, group classes, personal training, HIITZone, HydroMassage and tanning. Fitness Ventures, the largest Crunch franchise operator, opens 20+ gyms every year.

data.location: 555 The Shops at Mission Viejo, Mission Viejo, CA 92691
data.short_description: Tempur-Pedic is preparing to open a retail location at The Shops at Mission Viejo, as confirmed by CEO Cliff Buster. The store will feature mattresses, adjustable bases and bedding, with sleep consultants assisting customers. Store size, assortment and opening schedule have not been confirmed.

data.location: Miami
data.status: coming soon; hoping to open sometime next spring
data.short_description: ModWash is listed as "coming soon" in Miami, its first venture into the Miami area. The CEO said a groundbreaking ceremony is coming soon, with an opening hoped for next spring. An official address has not yet been released.

data.location: 8371 International Dr, Unit 90, Orlando, FL 32819 (ICON Park)
data.short_description: CardVault by Tom Brady plans to open its first Florida store within Orlando's ICON Park in mid-November 2026, in partnership with Charles Woodson and Jordan Edwards. The store will sell, buy and trade cards and collectibles and offer grading submissions. It is expected to be the company's 21st location, though an exact opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 3318 E Flamingo Rd, Suite 4D, Las Vegas, NV 89121 (Renaissance III Shopping Center)
data.short_description: AB's BBQ Fusion is working on opening its first brick-and-mortar restaurant, per a Clark County permit. The concept, from chef and content creator Aaron "AB" Brown, serves slow-smoked BBQ, Southern comfort food and Cajun and Creole flavors. The opening is listed as "coming soon" on the brand's website and social media.

data.location: 110 Place d'Orléans Dr, Orléans, ON K1C 2L9, Canada (Place d'Orléans Shopping Centre, former Starbucks space)
data.short_description: Café Van Houtte is coming to the former Starbucks space at Place d'Orléans Shopping Centre in Ottawa, with signage announcing "Opening Soon." An opening date has not been announced. The chain, part of MTY Food Group, already has an Ottawa location at Tanger Outlets.

data.location: 500 Fourth Ave, San Diego, CA 92101, United States
data.status: completed renovations; planning a grand opening celebration for mid-November
data.short_description: The former FLUXX Nightclub in the Gaslamp Quarter, closed since 2021, has been rebranded as The Quin, a private event venue. Renovations are complete and a grand opening celebration is planned for mid-November. The venue accommodates up to 910 guests and includes three full-service bars and an on-site kitchen.

data.location: 3676 N Wickham Rd, Melbourne, FL 32935
data.short_description: Greek Spot Cafe is planned for 3676 N. Wickham Road in Melbourne, according to a Florida DBPR application still under review on November 3. The applicant is Greek Foods Cafe LLC, managed by Constantino Papadatos. No opening date, menu or hours were provided.
